Suppress noise with an STFT Wiener mask. The noise profile is taken from noise_file/noise_file_base64 (noise-only reference sample) when provided, otherwise auto-estimated from the quietest frames. Parameters: noise_file, noise_file_base64, n_fft, hop_length, stationary, alpha, floor_db, smoothing_frames.

noise_file_base64.description: Optional base64-encoded WAV reference noise sample

stationary.description: True if the noise is stationary (default: true)

smoothing_frames.description: Time-smoothing of the gain mask in frames (default: 5)

post.description: Suppress reverberation via late-reverb attenuation. RT60 is measured from the input via Schroeder backward integration unless rt60_s is provided. Parameters: n_fft, hop_length, rt60_s, attenuation_db, mix.

rt60_s.description: Reverb decay time override in seconds (default: 0 = auto-detect)
